messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that can interact with a computer.

Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug A1: get_sky_light_level returns 15 below the world
Files: `pumpkin/src/lighting/runtime.rs`, both the sync and async variants
What is wrong: `section_index` is computed with an unsigned cast, so a `y` below `min_y` wraps to a huge index and hits the out-of-bounds branch, which returns 15.
Verified vanilla behaviour: Above build height 15 is correct. Below the world it is 0.
The change to make: Replace the unsigned index computation with a signed bounds check that distinguishes "above the top" from "below the bottom". Return 15 only for above.
Be careful: Do not simply flip the constant to 0; that breaks the above-build-height case which is currently right. Also `pumpkin-world/src/lighting/storage.rs` returns 0 for the same condition, so the two disagree; make them consistent.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.
